t1_scope_rule: T1 files are read only via bounded CodeGraph node ranges (offset/limit, each <=150 logical lines, non-truncated output). db.go (3657), sessions.go (3470), search_content.go (1462), recall.go (1495) are covered 1..EOF by contiguous ranges and marked full. messages.go is selective per task scope (message read/write, pagination, FTS-linked regions) and marked partial with exact missing ranges. CodeGraph reports total_lines+1 for these files (a trailing virtual EOF line); that extra line is not a logical source line and is not counted. Hashes alone were never counted as reading.
line_count_method: UTF-8 lines via [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines; 1-based inclusive read ranges; final newline does not create an extra logical source line.
